summary: Iteration 5 E2E verification of overlapping-job restriction, driver cancellation policy, driver-privacy masking, business terms checkbox gating, admin cancellation-policy settings, insufficient-funds enforcement, language switching (AR/EN/UR + dir), stat-card navigation, and admin login/OTP-block. Pytest: 6/6 iteration_5 tests pass after clearing test-state pollution on driver +966500000201 (was suspended by prior iterations exceeding cancel threshold). Full pytest suite: 67 passed, 4 skipped, 0 remaining failures. Frontend Playwright validated all requested flows on the preview URL.

minor.issue: Occasional wallet delta mismatch (460 vs 1000 SAR) — state pollution from prior iterations reserving/topping-up funds during parallel xdist runs; not a code bug

Send endpoint returns 200 + demo_otp for admin/staff phones; block only happens at /verify (403). Not a functional bug per spec, but sends a wasted OTP token & leaks role via timing. Consider blocking at /send too.

issues: Native <input type="date"> / <input type="time"> still used (data-testid req-date, req-time) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker + TimePicker — inconsistent with the rest of the design system under RTL. Carried from iter 3/4.
When a driver already has ~50+ pending offers, the page renders all cards linearly with no pagination/search — long scroll. Non-critical, but a UX enhancement.

action_items: (Low, backend) Block /api/auth/otp/send for admin/staff phones (return 403 immediately) to avoid wasting an OTP token and leaking role via response-time comparison.
(Design, carried from iter4) Replace native <input type="date"> / <input type="time"> in RequestNew.jsx step 3 with shadcn/ui Calendar & TimePicker.

(Test hygiene, low) Add a periodic cleanup / dev-only reset endpoint for driver.cancel_count + suspended_until so backend E2E suites stop accumulating suspensions across iterations. (Manually reset +966500000201 during this run — cancel_count was 4, suspended until 2026-09-19.)
critical_code_review_comments: Overlap restriction: routers/worker.py `ensure_acceptable` + `find_overlapping_job` correctly compute inclusive date-range intersection across offers in accepted/confirmed/attendance_confirmed/attended/driver_completed. Verified via test_iteration5.py::TestOverlapRestriction (200 for first, 400 OVERLAPPING_JOB for second). /api/worker/available also excludes overlapping requests — clean.

Driver-cancel: worker.py::cancel_job persists cancellations record, increments worker_profile.cancel_count, applies suspend at threshold, sets request.replacement_requested=true, reverts confirmed→filling, triggers match_workers — all verified. Empty-reason rejection at 400 works both API- and UI-side (jobs.cancelReason error toast displayed).

Privacy masking: business.py request_detail masks worker.phone unless offer.status in VISIBLE_AFTER_ACCEPT — confirmed live on request 0508e3ab... where accepted driver (+966500000201) shows phone but pending offers still render 'يظهر بعد القبول'. Good.

Business terms: RequestNew.jsx correctly disables wizard-publish-btn until biz-terms-checkbox is checked; publish call sends {terms:true} to backend; biz_terms_accepted_at persisted (verified via API GET /api/business/requests/{id}).

Insufficient-funds alert on wizard step 4 (data-testid=insufficient-funds-alert) displays required (24,975,000) / available (16,500) and links to /app/business/wallet via topup-now-btn — verified live.
AdminSettings cancel-policy-section: warn/suspend/days save via PATCH /api/admin/settings, persist across reload, and bounds (>30 days) rejected at 400 per test_iteration5 bounds test.
Language switching: <select data-testid=language-select> updates i18n context and toggles html[dir] between rtl (ar/ur) and ltr (en); no raw i18n keys visible in body text. Good.

Admin dashboard now exposes 10 stat- testids incl. stat-active-requests, stat-pending-withdrawals, stat-open-tickets, stat-noshows, stat-open-cases, stat-pending-docs — resolves iter-4 QA finding that only 4 cards had testids.

Business dashboard: all 8 stat-* cards (available/reserved/spent/fees/active/attendance/completed/cancelled) render as <a> tags with correct hrefs to /wallet or /requests — full stat-card navigation works.
OTP send-endpoint currently returns demo_otp even for admin/staff phones (blocked only at /verify with 403). Minor — should block at /send too.

success_rate.backend: 100% (67/67 non-skipped tests passing after test-state reset)

rca of the issue: N/A — no production bugs found. The two backend test failures on initial pytest run (topup delta + overlap/cancel 403) were TEST-STATE POLLUTION from previous iterations: (1) driver +966500000201 accumulated cancel_count=4 across iters 3/4/5 pushing him past cancel_suspend_threshold, and suspended_until got pushed to 2026-09-19 due to a prior test setting cancel_suspend_days to a large value before bounds enforcement was added; (2) business +966500000101 wallet had ongoing reservations from prior runs. Reset the worker profile (cancel_count=0, remove suspended_until) → all 6 iter5 backend tests + full E2E pass.
